jobs.prompt:
Write tools/png-signature.mjs: decodePng, gridSignature and compareSignatures of the design (section png-signature). Use node:zlib and a CRC32 table of your own. Keep it under 9000 characters.
Return each output file complete in files, never edits. ES modules, no dependencies, node:test and node:assert/strict for tests, no secrets in code or tests. Follow the design exactly: export names, return shapes, reasons and limits are fixed.

Write the test file for the png signature module (module written at the same time; use exactly the names in the design). The test file builds its own PNG fixtures with node:zlib (an encoder helper in the test: signature, IHDR, IDAT with filter 0 per row, IEND, CRC32). Cover: round trip of RGBA and RGB images, gray and gray-alpha, a palette image, filters 1 to 4 (build rows with each filter), a bad signature, a bad CRC, interlaced and 16-bit refused as png-unsupported, truncated pixel data, the size limits, gridSignature of a solid color and of a half-black image on a 4x4 grid, alpha composited on white, and compareSignatures for identical, opposite and different-size grids.
Return each output file complete in files, never edits. ES modules, no dependencies, node:test and node:assert/strict for tests, no secrets in code or tests. Follow the design exactly: export names, return shapes, reasons and limits are fixed.

Write tools/ui-compare.mjs: UI_DEFAULTS, validateUiConfig and compareScreen of the design (sections ui-compare and the Profile block ui). Keep it under 14000 characters.
Return each output file complete in files, never edits. ES modules, no dependencies, node:test and node:assert/strict for tests, no secrets in code or tests. Follow the design exactly: export names, return shapes, reasons and limits are fixed.

Write the test file for the ui compare module (module written at the same time; use exactly the names in the design). Cover: config validation (defaults, unknown keys, duplicate ids, absolute and dotdot mockup paths, bad routes, bad base urls like https or a remote host, bad viewport, start argv rules, too many screens, undefined raw) and compareScreen for every hard failure and the passing case: unstyled page, missing fonts (with a loader hash name like __Figtree_a1b2c3 counted as Figtree, generic fonts ignored), horizontal overflow, text mismatch and the skip for tiny mockups, colors missing with the per-channel tolerance and the skip, visual score under minScore, and the parts numbers.
Return each output file complete in files, never edits. ES modules, no dependencies, node:test and node:assert/strict for tests, no secrets in code or tests. Follow the design exactly: export names, return shapes, reasons and limits are fixed.
